name: Runner Tests Fixture - Tdd TestPage Triggers
brief: Proves --tdd (#5301) annotates a test that reaches a generated stub through what a TestPage runs on its source table.
description: Proves --tdd (#5301) annotates a test that reaches a generated stub through a TestPage's OpenNew, New or a field's SetValue, which run the source table's triggers and raise its database events, and leaves a test that only reads and moves unannotated.
